summary: Dependency-confusion beacon to external host on module load
details: @newspage/lib-ng-async-routes-ui@99.99.4 is a dependency-confusion artifact. The scoped name impersonates an internal-sounding namespace, and the implausibly high version (99.99.4) is the standard technique for winning resolution against a lower-versioned private package of the same name. On require(), the main module unconditionally issues an HTTPS GET to the hardcoded host accenture-npm.azurewebsites.net at the path /async, causing any environment that resolves and loads the package to beacon out to that endpoint. The outbound request discloses source IP and request metadata to the operator of that Azure Web App, confirming to an external party that an internal build or developer machine has pulled a package under this scope. No first-party relationship or caller consent exists; the destination is an external Azure Web App, not an Accenture-controlled domain.
